scope: Five previously uninspected archive-like entries remaining in the exact 43-path contest CDX result from pass5. Does not expand the query to an entire contest or every capture. Original archive content was examined statically; no original vendor program, kernel or macro executed.

archiveInspections.stopReason: Declared member compressed range exceeds available source bytes; no missing bytes inferred

referenceDecoder.method: Compiled the original Debian source locally with its bundled zlib/bzip2 sources; no vendor executable was used. Used direct binary file extraction for snull, not the Windows text-mode stdout pipe.

referenceAndKernelChecks.referenceSource: Debian unalz 0.65 original source, built unchanged locally

snull.extractionMode: Direct binary file output; Windows text-mode pipe output was not used for the decoded payload

linuxVersionStrings.text: Linux version 2.6.15.2-QplusESC4-v0.1-1 (root@r2d2.etri.re.kr) (gcc version 3.4.3) #6 PREEMPT Mon Jul 24 10:48:02 KST 2006

snullPresentation.technicalTopic: Linux SNULL memory-backed network interface driver; snull_init/open/tx/interrupt/rx, net_device callbacks and packet flow.
snullPresentation.inspectionMethod: Read-only CFB PowerPoint Document stream, all 1697 bounded records and 103 text atoms parsed; presentation code and macros not executed. No claim of visual slide rendering.

sourcePatchFindings.finding: Linux2.6.15.2-Contest board-file patch changes S3C2410_GPH6/GPH7 GPIO configuration to TXD2/RXD2 for ESTK2440 UART2.
Linux board/kernel sound support patch, including L3 bus configuration and SMDK2440 defconfig. This is not evidence of a GNEX runtime on the board.

sgsScan.method: Every byte offset; SGS v1/v2/v4/v36; plain and XOR-A5; bounded header, entry, variable and complete resource validation.
limits: Candidate requires nonzero START, at least one variable and resource, and at least 16 bytecode bytes; this is a conservative game scan.
Unknown proprietary packing and native ARM games are not ruled out.
Extraction preserves original bytes through the declared resource end, with a recognized 32-byte wrapper; unknown appended data is not guessed.
A structurally valid extraction is not proof that the game is playable.

limitations: The 43-path index contains 36 PDF/HWP paths and seven archive-like paths. All seven archives have now been obtained, but this does not mean that the 36 document bodies, all contest submissions, or an entire domain were searched.
The previous corp_idea.zip is still known to have three corrupt members; pass6 did not replace or repair it. face.zip was not downloaded again.

dnw050a.alz ends at exactly 2097152 bytes. Its 48th parsed member header declares a compressed range beyond EOF. The available bytes match CDX, but completeness, later members and reason for missing bytes are not established. No missing bytes were filled, and no split-volume filename was guessed.

The old unalz command can return exit code0 while printing 'corrupted file'. Its exit status alone is not used as evidence that DNW is complete; the bounded range test and individual CRCs are retained.

The U-Boot header has compression code0 and contains an ARM zImage. One internal gzip stream was verified separately; 109 following bytes were preserved and not assigned an invented role. No kernel boot test was performed.
Reference-board/kernel/source artifacts named ESTK2440, SMDK2440 or QplusESC4 are not classified as GNEX retail devices solely because the contest also had a GVM/GNEX track.
The SGS scan is the existing bounded v1/v2/v4/v36 plain/XOR-A5 recognizer. No accepted container does not exclude every proprietary packing or unknown embedded object format.

Compiled unalz is a local research decoder. The original DNW vendor application, Linux kernel, source patches, presentation macros and game code were not executed. No original binary is promoted to the runnable Reunion catalogue.
